title: The Body's Hidden Frame
intro: This quiz follows the story's exploration of the skeleton and how bones support, protect, and help the body move.

questions.prompt: What is the skeleton's main job?
choices: To support and give shape to the body
questions.explanation: The skeleton's main job is to support and give shape to the body.

questions.prompt: What important organs are protected by the rib cage?
questions.explanation: The rib cage protects the heart and lungs.

questions.prompt: How do bones help the body move?
choices: Bones work with muscles and joints
questions.explanation: Bones help the body move by working with muscles and joints.
